description: List the whiteboard's performance budgets the last runs exceed, with the limit and what was measured. Check it after a change, before saying the work is done.
name: get_budget_violations

description: Read the performance budgets the developer set on the whiteboard (latency p50 and p95 of each incoming call, peak memory, allocations, calls), each checked against the median of the last runs of `timonier test`: ok, exceeded, unmeasured, or attached to nothing the code has.
name: get_budgets

description: Compare the code with the developer's whiteboard: each drawn component and the real package or component it stands for (by name, then place), the drawn components the code lacks, the forbidden edges the code crosses with the dependencies that cross them, and the required edges it lacks. Check it after changing the structure.
name: get_drift

description: Read how this project instruments a language with OpenTelemetry: the SDK packages, the initialisation module, one span per public function with the code.* attributes, no span in hot loops. Read it before instrumenting code.

language.description: The language, as the packs name it: `rust`, `typescript`.

name: get_instrumentation_conventions

description: Check the instrumentation after a run of `timonier test`: the public functions no span was seen in (paged), the spans that lack code.function.name, code.file.path or code.line.number, those attached to no node of the graph, and the overhead of the traces against runs without them. The last finished run with traces unless one is given, `timonier doctor`'s smoke tests aside.

cursor.description: Where the previous page of never seen functions stopped (`next_cursor`).

limit.description: How many never seen functions per page: 1 to 500, 100 by default.

run.description: A run (`R-…`); the last finished one with traces when absent, `doctor`'s smoke tests aside.

name: get_instrumentation_gaps

description: Read the architecture the developer wants, from their whiteboard: layers, intended components (name, layer, role), edges with their policy (allowed, forbidden, required; between layers they hold for all their content), notes and performance budgets, where each shape and freehand stroke is drawn, and an image of the sketch for the freehand drawing. Read it before designing or changing the structure.

image.description: `false`: no image of the sketch, the structure and the places only.

name: get_intended_architecture

description: Read what a component cost in a run of `timonier test`: its incoming calls and their latency (p50, p95), the peak memory during them, the time spent in it, what inside took the most time, the tests that reached it, and its budgets.

component.description:
A component of the code or of the whiteboard: its id (`pkg:cargo/parser`, `C-1`) or its
name (`parser`, `Parser`).

run.description: A run (`R-…`); the last finished one with traces when absent, `doctor`'s smoke tests aside.

name: get_perf

description: Read the plan: milestones, their tasks, statuses and progress.
name: get_plan

description: Read the performance regressions of the last batch of runs (`timonier test --runs auto`) against the main branch: each measure (the run's CPU work, a test's duration, a function's own time) slower beyond doubt (Mann-Whitney p < 0.01) and by at least max(5 %, 3 MAD), probable when seen once, confirmed when the next batch sees it too.
name: get_regressions

description: Read a session of the journal: the open one, or the one given.

session_id.description: A session (`S-…`); the open one when absent.

name: get_session

description: Read the todo of the open session.
name: get_todo

description: Add a task to the plan, in an existing milestone or a new one, with its done criterion. Returns the task and its id (T-…).

criterion.description: What says the task is done.

new_milestone.description: The title of a new milestone for the task; or else `milestone`.

name: plan_add_task

description: Change a task of the plan: its status (todo, in_progress, blocked, done, dropped; only allowed transitions), title, criterion, or add a note. Returns the task.

note.description: Why; required to reopen a task that was done.

name: plan_update_task

description: Close the open session at the end of the work, with a summary of what was done and what is left. Returns the session as kept in the journal.

summary.description: What was done, and what is left, in a few sentences.

name: session_end

description: Open a work session before changing the code: give its objective, and the plan's task it serves if any. Writes to the plan and the todo need an open session. Returns the session.

objective.description: What the session is for, in a sentence.

task.description: The task of the plan it works on (`T-…`), if any.

name: session_start

description: Add an item to the todo of the open session, when splitting the work; link it to a task of the plan if any. Returns the item and its id (D-…).
name: todo_add

description: Mark an item of the todo as done, as soon as it is. Returns the item.
name: todo_complete
